posts.author: Glaiveworks
posts.body:
So i'm looking to have different "attack" actions depending on which character you are using.
For example:
Fighter Class: Default Attack and will say attack in the battle window
Marksmen: Basic Attack that needs a variable to use and will say fire in the battle window
The Marksmen's attack is going to be firing a revolver that requires at bullets to fire, and needs at least one to be used, if it's empty, there's a reload action the player can take to add 6 back to the ammo count.
Not sure where to start this, i have most of the parts of this working, just haven't gotten the separate attack actions part.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
basically you need a plugin for attack skill replace.
that allows you to define other skills as the skill used for attack
usually this is done based on weapon equipped, but other options should still be possible the same way.

posts.author: Timeline_man
posts.body: MV actually comes with the WeaponSkill plugin, which, as stated above, allows you to change the attack command to a different skill depending on the weapon. Then all you have to do is makes each weapon type class-specific and there you have it.
